newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Comfort to distribute Piaggio scooters.
newsitem.headline: Comfort to distribute Piaggio scooters.

text.p: Comfort Group Ltd (CGL) has secured the exclusive rights to import and distribute in Singapore scooters manufactured by Piaggio Veicoli Europei SpA, the company said on Tuesday.
Comfort said it had formed a fully-owned subsidiary, Comfort Eurobike Pte Ltd, to initially distribute the Vespa range of scooters produced by Piaggio.
The company is investing about Singapore $2 million in a Piaggio centre, which would include a showroom, workshop and offices.
"This Piaggio franchise has a strategic fit with the Group's car distribution business representing Peugeot, Maserati and SEAT," said Sam Chong Keen, managing director of CGL.
